description: Records progress on a claim in the person’s Untap account: sent (submitted to the operator or airline), paid (with the amount received, if known), rejected, or archived. Takes the claim_id given when the claim was saved or listed. This updates Untap’s record only; it does not contact the operator or airline. Requires sign-in to Untap.

amount_received_pence.description: For paid: the amount actually received, in pence. £12.40 = 1240.

claim_id.description: The claim_id given when the claim was saved or listed.

note.description: Optional short note, such as the operator’s reference or the reason given for a refusal.

status.description: sent: submitted to the operator or airline. paid: money received. rejected: the claim was refused. archived: hide it without an outcome.

name: update_claim_status
title: Update a claim’s status
